baseline.real_scenario: 开发提测后，qa 作为资深测试工程师结合测试用例先做测试准入和冒烟，快速判断提测质量；冒烟通过后按变更面裁剪执行功能、接口、Web/App、E2E、回归、NFR 和探索测试；测试通过后进入放行判断、上线准备与验收报告。
baseline.business_constraint: delivery-owner 是交付调度和循环 owner，负责开发提测、调度 qa/fixer、组织 Bug 评估和消费 QA 结果；qa 保持独立测试判断，负责提交缺陷文档和复测证据，但不直接改 Bug、不单独裁决业务风险或上线授权。
baseline.expected_outcome_signal: qa Skill 的默认流程能体现资深测试工程师真实顺序：提测接收 -> 测试准入 -> 冒烟 -> 测试执行与 Bug 提交/复测 -> 放行判断 -> 上线准备与验收报告，并能输出可被 delivery-owner 和 runtime gate 消费的 qa-result.json。
baseline.observed_pain: 现有 qa 容易被历史 gate 噪音牵引成 Phase 级结果填报器，触发点写成 code-review 通过后，流程直接按 QA_A-D 展开，缺少提测接收、冒烟准入、按产品形态裁剪测试范围、Bug 协同评估和上线准备语义。
baseline.protected_capability_candidate: 保留产品基线不可被实现反向定义、test-design handoff 不可猜测、真实运行路径、browser_required 必须浏览器证据、QAR 缺陷 triage、release recommendation、residual risk、uncovered boundary 和 Phase 级 qa-result.json。
baseline.entry_point_candidate: 从 Trigger、Responsibility、Input、Flow、Output、Resource、Determinism、Eval、Cleanup、Runtime 全环节检查 qa 是否围绕资深测试工程师流程成形；最终操作仍留到 SR-F1 冻结。
baseline.located_carrier: shared/skills/qa/SKILL.md plus contracts/qa-result.schema.json, templates/qa-result.template.json, scripts/completion_check.sh, references, evals, shared/agents/qa.md, shared/hooks/registry.json, shared/runtime/standard-chain-catalog.json, and installed Codex runtime copy at $HOME/.agents/skills/qa.
baseline.open_questions: SR-S2 关键假设已确认：冒烟失败时不进入功能/E2E/回归等常规测试，而是输出可复现缺陷或打回结论给 delivery-owner 调度修复。SR-F1 草案经用户纠偏：角色称为资深测试工程师；测试阶段需按前后端、App、Web 或后端/API 变更面裁剪，QA 提交 Bug 文档并与 delivery-owner 协同评估，不能直接改 Bug。

professional_domain.name: 资深测试工程师 / Senior QA Engineer
responsibilities: 确认开发提测包、测试用例、验收基线、环境和真实运行入口是否足以开始测试。
先执行冒烟准入，快速判断提测质量；冒烟失败时形成可复现缺陷或打回结论，不进入后续测试。
冒烟通过后，基于 test-design handoff、测试用例、变更范围和产品形态裁剪测试范围，执行功能、接口、Web/App、E2E、回归、NFR 和必要探索。
提交 Bug 文档、证据、影响判断和 owner hint，并与 delivery-owner 协同评估优先级、修复 owner、是否回归和复测范围。
修复后执行受影响范围复测，更新缺陷状态、证据、残余风险、未覆盖边界和放行建议。
测试通过后输出上线准备可消费的 Phase 级 qa-result.json 和人类验收报告投影视图。
non_goals: 不修改 implementation code，不直接修 Bug，不接受或豁免业务风险，不执行用户 sign-off 或提交授权。
不把 code-review-result.json、developer-report.json 或实现行为当作验收标准。
不在冒烟失败后继续执行功能、E2E、回归或探索来制造虚假完整度。
professional_domain.success_boundary: qa 能像资深测试工程师一样从提测接收推进到测试准入、冒烟、按变更面裁剪的测试执行、Bug 提交与协同评估、复测、放行判断、上线准备和验收报告；每个 PASS/FAIL、未执行项、风险和放行建议都能被 qa-result.json、证据引用、completion gate 与 delivery-owner 消费链路复验。

practice_flow: 提测接收：读取派发合同、active refs、测试用例、qa_handoff_contract、变更范围、环境入口和开发/验证证据。
测试准入：确认产品基线、test-design handoff、真实服务或等价运行路径、测试数据和阻断条件。
冒烟测试：结合测试用例覆盖关键路径、启动/入口、核心 AC 和高风险改动，判断提测质量。
冒烟打回：冒烟失败时记录 QAR 缺陷、复现步骤、影响、owner hint、证据和打回结论，并交给 delivery-owner 进入修复循环。
测试范围裁剪：基于变更面判断本轮涉及后端/API、Web 前端、App、前后端联动、数据/配置/第三方依赖或跨端旅程；未触发的测试类型记录 not_executed_reason。
测试执行：按裁剪范围执行功能/AC、接口/契约、前端 Web、App、E2E 用户旅程、异常恢复、回归影响面、NFR/专项和必要探索。
Bug 提交与协同评估：QA 提交 QAR 缺陷文档和证据，不直接改 Bug；delivery-owner 组织修复 owner、优先级、范围变化、风险接受或暂停裁决。
缺陷复测：fixer/developer 修复后，QA 重跑受影响验证面，更新 QAR 状态、stale evidence、回归影响和残余风险。
放行判断：汇总缺陷、未覆盖边界、已排除潜在问题、残余风险和 release recommendation。
上线准备与报告：输出 Phase 级 qa-result.json，必要时派生人类验收报告，供 delivery-owner、readiness gate 和上线准备消费。

test_scope_matrix.trigger_condition: 任何用户可观察行为、AC、业务规则或权限路径变更。

test_scope_matrix.not_triggered_rule: 无用户可观察行为或 AC 变化时记录不触发原因。

test_scope_matrix.trigger_condition: 后端、API、SDK、数据结构、错误码、权限、第三方集成或前后端契约变更。
test_scope_matrix.evidence: API command output, contract test, logs, database/query evidence
test_scope_matrix.not_triggered_rule: 纯前端展示变更且无接口契约变化时可 N/A。

test_scope_matrix.trigger_condition: Web 页面、路由、表单、组件状态、前端权限、浏览器交互或视觉/可用性变更。
typical_checks: 响应式、可访问性和 UX 检查点
test_scope_matrix.evidence: browser screenshot, trace/video, browser log, Playwright/webapp-testing output
test_scope_matrix.not_triggered_rule: 无 Web 入口或前端变化时记录不触发原因。

test_scope_matrix.trigger_condition: 移动端 App、H5 容器、端能力、登录态、推送、权限、安装/升级、离线/弱网或设备兼容变更。
typical_checks: 关键设备或 OS 兼容
test_scope_matrix.evidence: device/simulator record, screenshot/video, logs, network trace, QAR when failed
test_scope_matrix.not_triggered_rule: 本轮不涉及 App 或端能力时 N/A。

test_scope_matrix.trigger_condition: 跨页面、跨服务、跨 UNIT、前后端联动、支付/登录/权限/重定向/核心业务闭环变更。
test_scope_matrix.evidence: journey table, browser/API evidence according to execution_mode, final state evidence
test_scope_matrix.not_triggered_rule: 无跨步骤用户旅程或 scope 裁剪时记录 not_executed_reason。

test_scope_matrix.trigger_condition: 共享模块、公共组件、接口契约、数据模型、配置、权限、关键业务路径或历史缺陷相关变更。
test_scope_matrix.evidence: TEST_CMD output, affected-path manual evidence, regression summary
test_scope_matrix.not_triggered_rule: 低风险独立变更仍至少说明影响面判断。

test_scope_matrix.trigger_condition: 性能、安全、隐私、可靠性、兼容性、可观测性、数据迁移、第三方依赖或容量风险被 test-design/design/变更面触发。
test_scope_matrix.evidence: specialty command/report, monitoring/log evidence, risk note or deferred reason
test_scope_matrix.not_triggered_rule: 未命中专项触发条件时不得假装已测，记录不触发或延后原因。

test_scope_matrix.trigger_condition: 高风险、新交互、复杂状态、需求模糊、人工判断强或历史缺陷密集区域。
test_scope_matrix.evidence: timeboxed charter, findings, QAR or observation
test_scope_matrix.not_triggered_rule: 低风险 scoped run 可 N/A，但需说明未探索原因。

problem_cards.next_cut_reason: 职责域是后续 Trigger/Input/Flow/Output 的上游裁决；若继续把 qa 理解成 gate 填报器，后面所有环节都会被历史噪音带偏。
problem_cards.symptom: shared/skills/qa/SKILL.md:3 触发描述写成 code-review 通过后端到端验收；shared/skills/qa/SKILL.md:64-71 流程从 Baseline 直接到 Execute/Decide/Emit；shared/skills/qa/SKILL.md:73-80 把冒烟混在 QA_A 内，没有提测准入和冒烟失败打回边界。
problem_cards.why_problem: 资深测试工程师会先用冒烟判断提测质量；冒烟失败还继续执行后续测试会浪费测试成本、污染缺陷优先级，并让 delivery-owner 看到虚假的完整测试进度。
problem_cards.target_shape: qa SKILL.md states the Senior QA Engineer role, starts from handoff receipt, separates smoke admission from scoped test execution, blocks follow-up testing on smoke failure, documents Bugs without fixing them directly, coordinates triage through delivery-owner, and still emits canonical qa-result.json for downstream consumption.
problem_cards.verification: After SR-F1 execution, prove qa description/flow includes Senior QA role, handoff receipt, smoke admission, smoke failure BLOCK/return, scoped Web/App/API/E2E/regression/NFR/exploratory testing, Bug documentation with delivery-owner triage, retest loop, release readiness, and canonical qa-result completion evidence.
problem_cards.applicability: Applies because user-confirmed real workflow and current delivery-owner DO-S6/DO-S7 separate development handoff from QA execution.
problem_cards.non_applicability: Does not authorize changing delivery-owner ownership, accepting business risk, or removing canonical runtime qa-result consumption.
problem_cards.candidate_signal_source: User correction, local SKILL.md trigger/flow text, and current delivery-owner SOP.
problem_cards.counter_evidence: If downstream runtime only supported a single Phase gate with no QA agent autonomy, the change would need runtime redesign first; current delivery-owner explicitly dispatches qa agent and consumes independent QA result.
problem_cards.stop_condition: If schema/runtime consumers cannot represent smoke admission, mark the schema/template/runtime mismatch as SR-R5/SR-R10 issue and stop before execution.

problem_cards.next_cut_reason: 触发错误会让 qa 在错误阶段出现，优先级高于局部字段调整。
problem_cards.symptom: shared/skills/qa/SKILL.md:3 仍写 code-review 通过后触发。
problem_cards.why_problem: 最新 delivery-owner 把 QA 放在开发提测后，且 verifier PASS 后进入 QA 候选；code-review 触发会错过提测包和冒烟准入语义。
problem_cards.target_shape: 触发描述改为开发提测后测试工程师验收，并明确相邻分流。
problem_cards.verification: rg confirms active trigger no longer says code-review passed as the primary entry.
problem_cards.applicability: Applies to active runtime trigger metadata.
problem_cards.non_applicability: Does not trigger qa before a valid handoff.
problem_cards.candidate_signal_source: User correction and latest delivery-owner SOP.
problem_cards.counter_evidence: If code-review were still the only dispatch event, delivery-owner would not have DO-S6/DO-S7.
problem_cards.stop_condition: Stop if runtime catalog requires code-review wording for dispatch.

problem_cards.next_cut_reason: 缺提测包、verifier PASS 或真实入口会让冒烟不可执行。
problem_cards.symptom: shared/skills/qa/SKILL.md:36-44 缺少 development handoff、verifier PASS、测试焦点、变更产品形态、环境入口和 smoke scope。
problem_cards.why_problem: 资深测试工程师没有提测上下文和变更面就会把验收变成从文件猜测，无法判断提测质量，也无法裁剪 Web/App/API/E2E 等测试范围。
problem_cards.target_shape: 输入分为提测准入必需项、测试用例义务、真实运行入口、变更产品形态和可选风险上下文。
problem_cards.verification: Missing handoff/verifier/env/test_cases_ref/change surface scenarios produce BLOCK/NEEDS_INPUT rather than inferred testing.
problem_cards.applicability: Applies because test cases and handoff contract already encode QA obligations.
problem_cards.non_applicability: Does not require qa to own upstream artifact generation.
problem_cards.candidate_signal_source: Local input list and test-design handoff contract.
problem_cards.counter_evidence: If delivery-owner dispatch packet carried no QA context, this would require delivery-owner changes first.
problem_cards.stop_condition: Stop if delivery-owner packet schema cannot carry required refs.

problem_cards.next_cut_reason: 真实测试顺序决定 qa 是否像测试工程师工作，是本轮核心。
problem_cards.symptom: shared/skills/qa/SKILL.md:64-80 从 Baseline 直接 Execute QA_A-D，冒烟失败没有分支。
problem_cards.why_problem: 冒烟失败后继续后续测试会制造虚假覆盖、浪费测试资源，并延迟 Bug 评估和修复循环。
problem_cards.target_shape: 流程显式包含提测接收、测试准入、冒烟、冒烟失败打回、按变更面测试、Bug 文档与 delivery-owner 评估、复测、放行判断、上线准备与报告。
problem_cards.verification: Smoke FAIL sample never marks later testing PASS; scoped samples record why Web/App/API/E2E/NFR/exploration did or did not run.
problem_cards.applicability: Applies to all full QA runs and scoped QA runs after admission.
problem_cards.non_applicability: Does not force regular QA when scope only requests smoke.
problem_cards.candidate_signal_source: User correction and current flow table.
problem_cards.counter_evidence: If QA_A stage itself were defined as entire regular testing, adding smoke branch would be incompatible; local test-design defines QHO-SMOKE separately.
problem_cards.stop_condition: Stop if QA_A compatibility cannot be preserved.

problem_cards.next_cut_reason: 冒烟准入若不落到可消费输出，会停留在话术。
problem_cards.symptom: qa-result schema has QA_A-D stage_results but no explicit smoke_admission, scoped test matrix, Bug triage or handoff_quality field.
problem_cards.why_problem: 下游无法确定后续测试是否是在冒烟通过后执行，也无法自动阻止冒烟失败后的虚假 PASS，或区分未涉及 Web/App/API 与漏测。
problem_cards.target_shape: qa-result.json backward-compatible 增加 smoke_admission、test_scope_matrix、bug_triage_summary、handoff_quality 表达或在 stage_result 中强制可读。
problem_cards.verification: Schema/template validation and readiness gate tests cover smoke pass/fail, scoped test matrix and Bug triage variants.
problem_cards.applicability: Applies because qa-result is machine fact source.
problem_cards.non_applicability: Do not copy full schema fields into SKILL.md.
problem_cards.counter_evidence: If existing stage_results.additionalProperties is sufficient and tests consume it, schema change can be minimal.
problem_cards.stop_condition: Stop if adding required field would break existing active fixtures without migration.

problem_cards.next_cut_reason: 冒烟准入需要方法论，但不该塞进 SKILL.md 主体。
problem_cards.symptom: references 缺独立 smoke admission 与 scoped test execution 方法，regression reference 内有冒烟清单但用途不对。
problem_cards.why_problem: 资深 QA 的准入判断和按变更面裁剪测试会被拆散到 QA_A 或回归语境，主流程无法轻量路由。
problem_cards.target_shape: 新增或抽出 smoke-admission-methodology.md 与 scoped-test-execution-methodology.md，分别承载准入判断/打回证据和 Web/App/API/E2E/回归/NFR/探索裁剪规则。
problem_cards.verification: SKILL.md 仅在准入步骤读取该 reference，默认上下文不膨胀。
problem_cards.applicability: Applies to QA smoke admission only.
problem_cards.counter_evidence: If regression reference is explicitly reused by QA_A admission after rewrite, new file may be unnecessary.
problem_cards.stop_condition: Stop if adding reference has no caller in SKILL.md.

problem_cards.next_cut_reason: 机器可判定的冒烟失败后续阶段矛盾不应靠 LLM 自觉。
problem_cards.symptom: completion_check validates required fields、QAR 和 browser evidence，但不验证 smoke admission consistency.
problem_cards.why_problem: 报告可以声称冒烟失败同时后续测试 PASS，或没有说明 App/Web/API 未执行原因，gate 可能仍放行。
problem_cards.target_shape: 脚本或 schema/test 阻断 smoke FAIL 与后续阶段 PASS 的矛盾，并校验 scoped test matrix 基本形状。
problem_cards.verification: Negative fixture for smoke FAIL + later stage PASS is rejected; scoped matrix missing reason is rejected when applicable.
problem_cards.applicability: Applies to deterministic report consistency only.
problem_cards.non_applicability: Does not automate subjective exploratory quality.
problem_cards.counter_evidence: If smoke status remains pure natural-language evidence, deterministic gate cannot enforce it and schema must change first.
problem_cards.stop_condition: Stop if no machine-readable smoke field is adopted.
